method.kind_table: 0x80096b98 (extent derived by cross-level intersection; see kind_extent_proof)

kind_extent_proof.rule: cross-level intersection: extent = min over levels of the first non-plausible slot index; plausible = pointer in 0x80000000..0x80200000
kind_extent_proof.note: past-end slot plausibility VARIES by level (a real table cannot), which is itself evidence those slots are not table entries
